question: I’ve heard that in the heroine and other female characters, the author’s preference in women will show up, but how is it in Mr. Greycat’s case? Are there any characters that show your preferences?
answer: Making the heroine silver-haired is entirely my own hobby. Aside from that, there’s not enough of it to mention, I guess. In my stories up to this point, the heroines don’t have a particular must-have feature common to all of them. If you weren’t able to like a character that will appear often, it would be a problem, so the thought that your preferences will show up is probably not wrong. I, too, don’t dislike any of the characters in Re: Zero.
